rationale: C206 is a real issuer_name parse leak. The raw SOI table separates Portfolio Company from Industry, Spread Above Index, Interest Rate, and Maturity Date. For rows 65-69, the source portfolio-company cells are OneCare Media, LLC plus the instrument name, with Media, SOFR + 6.50% (1.00% floor), 11.85%, and 9/29/2026 in separate columns. The flagged stored values instead concatenate those separate terms into issuer_name, so the column contains raw dimension/term text rather than the clean issuer.
